records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project or key milestone, Starter, no tickets, and no customer reply to onboarding email [email:2d915511]. Only positive signal is one teammate invite [slack:4f4eae7d]. Silent, low-activity accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting your first Wrenfield project set up
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

I noticed you've already invited a teammate to Wrenfield — nice start. The next step is usually creating a first project, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, so it doesn't take much to get rolling.

If it's easier, I'd be glad to hop on a short call this week and help you map your first project and tasks together — just reply with a couple of times that suit you.

Best,
Chidi
